mapper.select: SELECT id, source_listing_id AS sourceListingId, building_id AS buildingId, title, property_type AS propertyType, trade_type AS tradeType, deposit, monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, maintenance_fee AS maintenanceFee, area_m2 AS areaM2, floor_info AS floorInfo, room_number AS roomNumber, address, room_num AS roomNum, bathroom_num AS bathroomNum, park_availability AS parkAvailability, transaction_status AS transactionStatus, property_description AS propertyDescription, available_date AS availableDate, move_in_date AS moveInDate, update_date AS updateDate, discussion_status AS discussionStatus, dong FROM property WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT image_url FROM property_image WHERE property_id = #{id} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT infra_category AS category, count_within2000m AS count FROM infrastructure WHERE building_id = #{buildingId} AND count_within2000m > 0
